pool restaurant "Restaurant"
  lane guest "Guest"
    start hungry "Feeling hungry"
    task enter "Enter the restaurant"
    task choose "Choose a dish"
    task wait_turn "Wait until turn"
    task place "Place the order"
    task pickup "Pick up the meal"
    task eat "Eat the meal"
  lane employee "Employee"
    task enter_pos "Enter the order into the POS system"
    task collect "Collect the money"
    task setup "Set up the buzzer"
    task pass "Pass on the buzzer"
    task inform_chef "Inform the chef"
    task trigger "Set off the buzzer"
    task wait5 "Wait 5 minutes"
    task call "Call the guest"
    task handover "Hand over the meal"
    xor react "Guest reacts to the buzzer?"
  lane chef "Chef"
    task prepare "Prepare the meal"
    task place_hatch "Place meal in service hatch"
    task inform_emp "Inform the employee"
    end served "Meal eaten"

flow hungry -> enter -> choose -> wait_turn -> place -> enter_pos -> collect -> setup -> pass -> inform_chef
flow inform_chef -> prepare -> place_hatch -> inform_emp -> trigger -> react
flow react -> handover "yes"
flow react -> wait5 "no"
flow handover -> pickup -> eat -> served
flow wait5 -> call -> react
